items.title: Connected to Meta's models
items.body: The backend now talks to all four Meta models it needs, listening, directing, drawing and selecting, and each one passed a live test against the real service.

items.title: Building the engine
items.body: Started the backend: story rules, cast approval and budget guards, all tested before any UI.

items.title: Proved the hard parts
items.body: Our test scenes kept the same girl and cat on model across every panel, one click selected her cleanly, and voice-style edits changed her coat without disturbing the rest of the picture.

items.title: Mapped the Meta APIs
items.body: Read the docs for live speech, image editing and segmentation, and confirmed the pipeline works end to end on paper.

items.title: Marketing page is live
items.body: This page is now deployed on Azure Static Web Apps from our public repo. Every push to main updates this build log within a minute.

items.title: Project kicked off
items.body: Picked the idea, wrote the build plan and put this page up. The public live demo goes up on Nov 2.

items.title: Proving the hard parts first
items.body: Testing speech-to-shot-list, and whether one character stays recognisable across six panels.
